data.title: bn-2el: compute status and applicability
data.description: Security-sensitive computed status over linked records and retained originals. Check: can unlinked or invalid artifacts promote; can missing or modified originals evade integrity; can policy or binding changes misstate status; can audience and S/D selection hide newer evidence; can mixed-round results or cache assertions produce a false promotion? Review the profile eligibility and truthful intermittent summary boundary explicitly.

data.body: HIGH: Experiment lookup is global-by-digest, so ordinary repeated runs can turn status into integrity_failure. Trigger: publish two records for the same lead from different request keys while their frozen experiment bytes are identical; preflight records the experiment per request key, so the lineage may contain two distinct artifact IDs with the same digest. Impact: capture retains both records' inputs, then this method sees two digest matches and returns DigestMismatch before either exact record lineage is checked; Status.compute therefore fails integrity instead of selecting the latest S/D. Reachability: this is the normal re-verification path, not a forged artifact path. Detection gap: the current status tests reuse one experiment artifact / one published record and synthetic records, so they never present equal experiment bytes under distinct IDs. Fix/test: resolve the experiment only from the exact linked record artifact's lineage, require exactly one matching input there, and add a two-published-record regression with identical experiment digests but different experiment artifact IDs; keep missing or duplicate matches within that one record as integrity failures.

data.reason: HIGH th-lujwu4: repeated normal runs with identical experiment bytes under distinct artifact IDs are rejected by global digest lookup, forcing integrity_failure instead of computing S and D.

data.body: Fixed: experiment lookup first authenticates the exact linked record artifact and reads only that record’s retained ordered lineage. Exactly one lineage input must match the experiment digest; missing or duplicate matches fail integrity, and the full Artifact identity is used for the read. A regression publishes two distinct runs and receipts with equal experiment digests but distinct artifact IDs, verifies S and D, and exercises duplicate and missing inputs. Synced onto f12ee1fd550d; verifier library 25/25, strict all-features Clippy, diff check, and RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 just check passed.

Re-review confirms the fix at exact target 7d472628fb178f4ace55b5d2ad888f8a619341ee. The exact linked (Artifact, VerificationV1) pair is authenticated before read_record; experiment_reference searches only that record's ordered lineage inputs; zero matches returns MissingOriginal, multiple matches returns DigestMismatch, and EvidenceSnapshot::read requires a unique artifact ID plus full Artifact equality and byte digest. The published regression creates distinct run IDs, intents, record artifacts, experiment artifact IDs and receipts while the experiment bytes/digest are equal, then obtains the correct positive S and later negative D; injected per-record duplicate and missing matches both compute IntegrityFailure. No snapshot-global digest search or unlinked/lookalike fallback remains. Failure-mode check: broken chain/manifest/canonical bytes/originals fail closed; edge cases cover equal digests under distinct IDs plus zero/duplicate lineage matches; rollback is the frozen three-commit range revert before merge; monitoring is typed INTEGRITY_FAILURE with S/D IDs withheld on capture failure; validation pins chain sequence/predecessors, full artifact identity, canonical bytes, ordered lineage and manifest/binding chronology. Focused verifier library 25/25, strict workspace all-target/all-feature Clippy, git diff check, and RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 just check pass; first sandbox-only just-check attempt failed before worker startup because mise cache was read-only, then passed under normal host permissions.

data.reason: Fixed at 7d472628: record-specific ordered-lineage lookup proven by published equal-digest/distinct-artifact regression; zero and duplicate matches fail closed.

LGTM exact target 7d472628fb178f4ace55b5d2ad888f8a619341ee: whole persisted f12ee1fd..7d472628 range reviewed; th-lujwu4 fixed by record-specific exact lineage resolution with genuine equal-digest/distinct-receipt publication coverage; no new findings; 25/25 focused tests, strict Clippy, diff check and serialized full just check pass.
